observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with a black plastic cover over the top.
The engine is mounted on a metal stand.
There is visible rust and dirt on the metal components.
A multi-colored wiring harness is visible on the right side.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder unit based on the shape of the cylinder head cover.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may not start or run.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running with the cover removed.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or seized parts.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and a photo of the engine block.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing critical components like the timing belt or water pump.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with all components visible.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine block and all attached components.
Photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the block).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
